successor_assignment.semantics: This contract assigns the exact successor ID for the fail-closed fallback class that WP1C4B2C intentionally left unassigned. The ID is not claimed to have been pre-specified by the predecessor.

conditional_domain.name: D_cond
conditional_domain.chi_periodicity: 2pi periodic modulo the frozen U1 patch contract
conditional_domain.pole_regularity: smooth Cartesian extendibility at each disk pole; do not impose naive componentwise scalar power laws on tensors or one-forms
conditional_domain.scalar_fourier_control: for a genuine scalar mode f_n near a smooth polar origin, f_n=O(r^abs(n))
conditional_domain.interface: preserve two-side gluing and moving-interface kinematics from WP1C
conditional_domain.gauge_closure: bulk diffeomorphism, U1, and independent intrinsic interface-reparameterization parameters must each map D_cond into itself
conditional_domain.intrinsic_reparameterization_domain: one common rho^a(y) on the glued interface; rho preserves tangential support, 2pi chi periodicity, smooth pole extendibility and the common two-side interface chart

U1.proof: delta d_a = D_a(q_sigma lambda)-q_sigma D_a lambda = 0 for constant q_sigma
U1.surface_reparameterization_note: d_a is U1 invariant but transforms as an interface one-form perturbation under an independent intrinsic chart reparameterization; U1 invariance is not surface-chart invariance

moving_interface_bulk_diffeomorphism.pulled_metric: delta_zeta p_ab = 2 D_(a zeta_parallel_b) + 2 K_ab zeta_perp
moving_interface_bulk_diffeomorphism.invariant_induced_metric: H_ab = p_ab + 2 xi_shape K_ab + 2 D_(a tau_b)

intrinsic_surface_reparameterization.bulk_fields: no independent bulk-field gauge transformation; only interface pullback representatives/components are reparameterized
intrinsic_surface_reparameterization.pullback_tensor_rule: for an interface perturbation t of background pullback Tbar, delta_rho t = Lie_rho Tbar in the active convention used here
intrinsic_surface_reparameterization.induced_metric_rule: delta_rho H_ab = Lie_rho hbar_ab = 2 D_(a rho_b)
intrinsic_surface_reparameterization.domain_restrictions: rho has the same support, chi-periodicity, smooth-pole and common-gluing admissibility requirements as D_cond
intrinsic_surface_reparameterization.sign_note: WP1C3 states the independent surface-coordinate symmetry geometrically; reversing passive/active parameter sign changes component signs but not its independence or quotient status

svt_semantics.reason: a physical time function/spatial slicing and causal background are not frozen
svt_semantics.conditional_bookkeeping: 4D-covariant York/Hodge orbit decomposition only where the required projectors exist on the declared analytic domain
svt_semantics.formal_metric_split: h_munu = hTT_munu + 2 D_(mu VT_nu) + (D_mu D_nu - qbar_munu D2/4) B + qbar_munu H/4

kinematic_quotient.meaning: quotient by all explicit bulk-diffeomorphism, U1 and independent intrinsic surface-coordinate gauge orbits that preserve D_cond
missing_for_physical_phase_space: gauge generators from the canonical constraint system

constraint_elimination.direct_elimination_condition: C must be invertible on the correctly gauge/constraint-reduced declared domain

regime_checks.a_F_to_zero: declared Maxwell-scalar decoupling control; does not close constraints or physical SVT
regime_checks.internal_n_zero: must be retained; no division by n is allowed
regime_checks.large_abs_n: stronger polar regularity but no KK spectrum claim
regime_checks.projector_zero_modes: must be separated before any inverse/projector is used
regime_checks.pure_intrinsic_chart_mode: must remain in G_cond and must not enter the later physical-mode or kernel count as an independent tangential excitation

forbidden_inferences: Bulk diffeomorphisms and intrinsic interface-coordinate reparameterizations are distinct gauge symmetries and must not be identified.
A pure tangential interface chart reparameterization is not an additional physical mode.
The conditional 4D-covariant decomposition is not a physical cosmological 3+1 SVT decomposition.
A kinematic gauge quotient is not the physical reduced phase space.
A formal Schur complement is not the physical kinetic matrix.
A singular auxiliary block may not be inverted or silently pseudoinverted.
No physical DOF count is released before ULSH04 closes the constraint algebra on a released background.
No ghost, gradient, tachyon, KK-spectrum or stability claim follows.
No 6D-to-4D observable map or HZT identification of Phi, Psi, Delta_m, mu, eta or Sigma follows.
No backend import or solver execution is authorized.
